text:
```yaml
name: CLAUDE.md Size Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths: [ "CLAUDE.md" ]

jobs:
  check-claude-size:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check CLAUDE.md character count
        run: |
          CHAR_COUNT=$(wc -m < CLAUDE.md)
          echo "CLAUDE.md character count: $CHAR_COUNT"
          
          if [ $CHAR_COUNT -gt 25000 ]; then
            echo "❌ CLAUDE.md exceeds maximum size of 25,000 characters"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ CLAUDE.md size is within limit"
          fi
```
